title: From classical bits to qubits
subtitle: Amplitudes, measurement, and interference
description: A concise introduction to qubit state vectors, measurement probabilities, unitary gates, and Hadamard interference, starting from classical bits.

title: Two qubits and the Bell-state example
subtitle: Joint states, tensor products, and entanglement
description: Build two-qubit states, learn tensor products and CNOT, and prove that the Bell state is entangled.

title: Pauli operators and stabilizer constraints
subtitle: Describe a quantum state through the equations it satisfies
description: Learn Pauli matrices, signed Pauli strings, commutation, and stabilizer generators through the Bell-state example.

title: Why the state has a compact description
subtitle: A proof that n independent constraints determine one state
description: Prove the compact-description theorem for stabilizer states using projectors and trace, and encode generators using O(n²) bits.

title: Updating generators under Clifford gates
subtitle: Track H, S, and CNOT using local rules and exact signs
description: Derive Clifford conjugation, learn signed H, S, and CNOT updates, and follow the Bell circuit using stabilizer generators.

title: Sampling the final measurements
subtitle: Deterministic outcomes, fair coins, and conditional states
description: Prove and implement the two stabilizer measurement cases using binary Gaussian elimination and exact generator updates.

title: The Gottesman–Knill theorem and its proof
subtitle: An exact classical sampler, with correctness and runtime bounds
description: Assemble a complete proof that H, S, and CNOT circuits with final computational-basis measurements admit exact classical sampling in polynomial time.
